notes: THE HIGH ANCHOR. This file is staged only into the verifier image and is never on the agent surface. It is a BAR, not a claim to be the optimum of this space: it is the policy an authoring search over this harness found to maximise expected reward across the five declared ramp starts, and a submission that reaches or beats it scores 1.0. Its distinguishing finding is that with the onset drawn, the budget is better spent on FOUR well-separated probes at three batches each than on either six cheap ones or two precise ones: three batches is enough to cut the 0.18-nat per-batch spread to about 0.10, which is below the gap between the turn and its neighbours on every draw, and four probes placed at 832 / 1152 / 1536 / 1856 bracket the turn for all five onsets. Plain argmin beats argmin_smoothed here because the minimum is narrow once the readings are resolved, and smoothing blurs it.
